I've answered Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

That comes from two places Marcus can see himself. Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged the duplicate arrivals on door 6 during the morning shift. The public North cheat sheet also lists Thea as the main contact for Quarrendon Freight Lines.
